description: Assign fluid properties to zones. Gating: requires model configure matrixflow (zoning then creates matrix flow arrays/knots). Probe trap: with any first token other than 'property' the live engine reports 'block zone fluid: command not found' (misleading - the command exists, verified under matrixflow).

keywords.name: property
keywords.description: Assign fluid properties to matrix zones. Property names (official 9.7 page; porosity state-verified live: 'Fluid property porosity set in 48 zones'): permeability (mobility coefficient, SI m^2/(Pa*s)), porosity.

keywords.name: porosity
keywords.description: Set the fluid flow mobility coefficient in the matrix zones (SI units of m 2 /(Pa/s)). Set the porosity for fluid flow in the matrix zones.
